quote: Except as otherwise provided in this Chapter: No person shall stand or park a vehicle in a roadway other than parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.

activation.condition: A person stands or parks a vehicle in a roadway, subject to another provision of this Chapter.

obligation.description: Vehicle is parallel with the roadway edge and headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.

exceptions.effect: Potential displacement or qualification of this clause; unresolved pending Chapter review
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in this Chapter

timing.description: During the observed standing or parking interval.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: parallel with the edge of the roadway
judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric angle tolerance is supplied; retain measured geometry for later judgment.

parameter_refs.name: roadway_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed roadway, edge and lawful one-way direction

parameter_refs.name: activity_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed stand or park purpose, person and Chapter context
